architecture_guide.concept: A small proposed static-site module graph. Pure domain contracts feed resource ports, injected adapters and services, then UI and outer workflows. Existing root HTML/CSS/data files are integration targets, not already migrated modules. No backend or agent layer is required. Same-layer dependencies must be acyclic; cross-layer imports follow dependency_rules. The root scaffold task is the one setup exception to task/unit equivalence.

rings.rule: Zero external deps. Pure entities, value objects, aggregates, domain events. Everything else depends on this.
Depends only on domain. Schema-only port interface contracts. Infrastructure implements them; application calls them.
Implements port contracts. NEVER imported by application — injected at runtime via registry.
Standalone atomic tools (parsers, writers, searchers). Self-contained input-to-output functions. No business logic.
Orchestrates domain via port interfaces only. Stateless use-case handlers. Never imports concrete infrastructure.
Display modules. Consume gateway data shapes or application read models. No business logic.
End-to-end composition graphs. workflow.json wires unit IDs from registry.json. The outermost ring.

atomic_unit_contract.description: Every planned leaf unit contains a contract, identity, implementation and meaningful fixtures. Schema-only ports may expose pure interface validation; browser and workflow contracts additionally require integration evidence. Same-layer imports are allowed only without cycles. Workflows are the composition roots and may wire adapters, tools and UI while services remain infrastructure-independent.

required_slots.schema.json: Contract — inputs, outputs, errors. The unit public surface. Other units reference this.
required_slots.manifest.json: Identity — id, type, version, layer, relations to other units, API surface.
required_slots.main.js: Implementation — exports the entry symbol declared in manifest.json.
required_slots.tests/unit.json: Tests — array of {input, expected_output} pairs validating the contract.

optional_slots.state.js: Runtime state machine for stateful agents and workflows.
optional_slots.prompt.md: System prompt and few-shot examples for AI agent units.
optional_slots.ui/: UI companion component for units that have a visual interface.
optional_slots.workflow.json: For workflow units, composition of registry IDs.

atomic_unit_contract.registry_rule: src/registry.json is created by task 1 and updated per task. Every listed unit starts planned; stable requires implementation and recorded validation. Existing source entry points remain supported during migration.

tasks.task_name: Establish release scope, registry and reproducible project commands

Create the small atomic-unit registry and Node tooling used by this plan, preserving root index.html, app.js, styles.css and data files as integration entry points. The supplied v3.3 document is a populated template, not an executable JSON Schema; make the distinction explicit. Source folders below are proposed deliverables, not existing code.

tasks.task_name: Validate scientific evidence and confidence methodology
tasks.description: Create the evidence contract and curate a source ledger for every physiological, FACS and action claim plus every quantitative score. Existing percentages, T1-T4 tiers, BSM consensus and diagnostic-specificity labels have no linked methodology in data.json. Research primary sources, distinguish self-reported body maps from measured physiology and facial coding, and document the owner-requested source-based audit by Codex; do not claim independent human certification. The legacy emotional-somatic-map.html references are research leads, not automatic proof of each claim.

verification.success_signal: Add sources.json and stable per-claim/metric source IDs, evidence type, population, limitations, review status and review date. Every published empirical number has a traceable derivation and denominator; unsupported estimates are removed or clearly labeled editorial estimates rather than empirical or diagnostic probabilities. Qualify causal and universal statements; document individual/context variation and that FACS coding does not by itself establish emotion or diagnosis. Independent evidence reviewer records decisions for all current claims and metrics, unresolved claims are withheld from the validated release, and no fabricated citations or sign-off is accepted. A machine check verifies citation integrity and policy fields; human review remains a separate scientific release gate.
